answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded escrow account whose balance is attested through a Merkle-anchored ledger, so a comet of fresh pseudonyms cannot ripple through the registry without posting collateral that traces to a verified dune of prior settlement history. Forensic auditors sample these bond proofs and cross-check counterparty graphs. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
